summary: Innoviz Technologies Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) reporting the results of its annual general meeting held September 16, 2026. Shareholders of record as of August 12, 2026 approved the re-election of Class III directors Amichai Steimberg, Omer Keilaf and Alexander von Witzleben through 2029, Yoav Har Even as a Class II director through 2028, authorizing the board to effect a reverse share split at a 1-for-5 to 1-for-20 ratio, and ratifying Kesselman Kesselman (PwC Israel) as auditors. No special-situation transaction is implicated.
